settings.content: The five brand grounds. Every section colour comes from these, so changing one here changes it everywhere.
Leave any of these blank and the line is hidden rather than guessed. Nothing here should be a rounded up estimate: it appears next to the add to cart button and customers will hold you to it.

settings.label: Dispatch cut-off time
settings.info: For example 2pm AEST. Orders before this on a business day are dispatched the same day.

settings.label: Metro delivery window
settings.info: For example 2 to 4 business days. Melbourne, Sydney, Brisbane, Adelaide, Perth, Canberra, Hobart.

settings.label: Express delivery window
settings.info: For example next business day to most metro addresses.

settings.label: When email is answered
settings.info: For example 8am to 6pm AEST, Monday to Friday.

settings.label: Character limit
settings.info: The card is printed, so this is a physical limit rather than a preference.

settings.label: Klaviyo public API key
settings.info: The popup itself is built in Klaviyo, not here, so it can be changed without a theme deploy.

settings.label: Judge.me installed
settings.info: When ticked the reviews section renders the Judge.me widget. Until real reviews exist it shows an honest empty state and no star rating.
